name: Smoky Paprika Chicken Frittata with Pepper, Zucchini & Dressed Greens

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 orange bell peppers
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise ½-inch thick pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Once the chicken is done, add veggies to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs and salt in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, and salt in a clean large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with dressed greens on the side and enjoy!
